_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (CLAUDE.md, 'Code organization: 500-line file convention'), as of 2026-08-12. checkFileLength.mjs fails only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, or a listed file grows past the line count recorded here. Splitting a file below 500 lines does not require touching this file (the script reports it as a housekeeping notice instead of failing) but delete the entry once it's split. Do not bump a recorded number to silence a GREW violation — split the file, or if truly justified, say why right here.
_note_src_game_Game_ts: 1348→1256 (2026-08-12): two form-② composition extractions landed — controllers/ForgeActions.ts (craft/cycle-character/acquire/clear/browse, zero cross-calls back into Game — every method takes MetaState + screen size as plain parameters) and controllers/ScreenFlow.ts (the 7 showX()/openSettings/pause/resume widget-hide-and-show mechanics, also zero callbacks back into Game — Game keeps owning `phase` itself since the main loop/run lifecycle/forge actions all read it equally, and just calls screenFlow.showX(...) after setting it). Both got real test coverage (ForgeActions.test.ts, ScreenFlow.test.ts) using this repo's established host-callback-interface pattern (see [[daydayup-testing-conventions]] / RunOutcome.ts, EventReactor.ts). What's LEFT in Game.ts (run lifecycle: beginRun/beginTutorialRun/beginArenaDemoRun/finalizeOnlineRun/quitRun; the main loop: update/advanceSim/advanceOnline/stepSim/updateFx/updateCamera/updateHud; matchmaking connect glue) genuinely fails form②'s own cross-call test — nearly every one of those methods reads/writes `phase`/`engine`/`session`/`meta`/`scene`/`roomBuilder`/`fx` in combination, not a short countable list crossing one clean boundary; forcing an artificial split here would just relocate the same coupling through more callback ceremony, per CLAUDE.md's own 'genuine two-way dependency' guidance. Recorded as tracked debt, not solved — a future pass with a dedicated testing budget (Game.ts itself has no test file, by longstanding user-accepted exemption: constructing it needs a live Pixi Application) should revisit the main-loop/run-lifecycle boundary specifically, not the whole file at once.
